questions.q: A PX4 vehicle in Position mode is "afraid" to fly backward although there is nothing there. What is the companion sending (an OBSTACLE_DISTANCE fragment)?
questions.fragment:
increment=5  angle_offset=0  min_distance=20  max_distance=1000  frame=BODY_FRD
distances[0..8]   = 412 398 377 ... (camera, forward sector)
distances[9..71]  = 0 0 0 0 0 ... 0
options: The sectors outside the field of view are filled with 0 instead of 65535 (no data): the autopilot sees "an obstacle touching the sensor"
BODY_FRD rotates with the vehicle, so the "forward" sector moved to the back after a 180° turn
max_distance = 1000 cm is less than the camera range, so the rear sectors count as occupied
increment = 5 gives only 72 sectors, while PX4 expects 360 sectors of one degree each
questions.explain: "No data" is encoded as UINT16_MAX; 0 does not mean "unknown": PX4 1.18 puts it into the map as an obstacle touching the sensor (ArduPilot 4.7 discards zeros).
